description: This Java class defines a service handler for creating external asset owner loan product attributes within the Fineract investor module. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and processes commands to create new attributes via the ExternalAssetOwnerLoanProductAttributesWriteService.

classes.name: CreateExternalAssetOwnerLoanProductAttributeHandler
classes.description: A service class responsible for handling creation commands for external asset owner loan product attributes within the system.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a JsonCommand to create a new external asset owner loan product attribute by delegating to the write service.
